title: Add Craftable Totems
description: This will allow you to craft totems of undying using some ore materials
body:
This mod adds craftable totems of undying to minecraft using some rare ores, such as gold and iron

HOW TO CRAFT

[The crafting table recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c404f0bfe03658d9587661088a70b9c80c16137.png)

If your struggling to find a woodland mansion, this mod is for you!

MORE VERSIONS WILL BE SUPPORTED SOON!
If you want more versions ported, or you are experiencing some problems/feedback click [here](https://forms.gle/Csm2Z1kRqE4jTPEm8).
